title: feat(spec): the remaining getSession readers read the declared AuthSessionApi result (user.isPlatformAdmin, role, name); the top-level activeOrganizationId fallback is removed
body:
Fixes #24222

Clause-②: yes

## What

`AuthSessionApi.getSession` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.ts`) says its result declares exactly the fields its in-process readers read. After #24196 (PR #24220), the other readers still read the session through `any` or a cast, and two of them read a top-level `activeOrganizationId` that the contract does not declare. This PR does both halves in one diff, as triage routed it (`6241789224`): the contract, and the readers.

### Contract: three optional `user` members, each with its reader named

| Declared | Type | Reader | Why this type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user.isPlatformAdmin` | `boolean` | `judgePlatformAdmin` (`@objectstack/plugin-auth`, via `isPlatformAdminUser`) | plugin-auth's own `customSession` derives it as a boolean (`auth-manager.ts`, `let platformAdmin = false`) |
| `user.role` | `string \| null` | same | better-auth's `admin` plugin schema declares it `type: "string", required: false`, so a row may hold null (the `impersonatedBy` precedent) |
| `user.name` | `string` | `dispatcher-plugin`'s concrete AI-route `req.user` resolver (`@objectstack/runtime`), the actor's display name | `buildActorUser`'s `displayName?: string`. The card did not list this read. Removing the `any` from `resolveSessionData` turned it into a compile error (TS2339 on `user.name`), and that is how it was found |

The docblock gains a `[#24222]` paragraph: the remaining readers read the declared result, and none reads a top-level `activeOrganizationId`.

### Readers: each one reads the declared result (route a). Types only, runtime behaviour unchanged

Each site gets a module-local `SessionRead` alias, `Awaited<ReturnType<NonNullable<AuthSessionApi['getSession']>>>`, the spelling #24196 used. Each read gets a one-line `[#24222]` comment.

- **`@objectstack/plugin-auth`**: the four platform-admin mounts in `auth-plugin.ts` (`toggle-disabled`, `gateAdmin`, `unlock-user`, `has-permission`). The two `(authApi as any).getSession(…)` calls are un-cast, and all four now read into `SessionRead | null`. `authApi` is better-auth's own `Auth['api']`, so **better-auth's concrete session type now has to be assignable to the declaration**. It is: a probe assigning that read to `number` failed with `{ session: { id: string; …; token: string; … }; user: … } | null is not assignable to type 'number'`, so the type is concrete, not `any`. In `has-permission`, the `{ user?: { id?: unknown } }` cast is gone. `judgePlatformAdmin` reads `(session as SessionRead | null)?.user` instead of a `Record<string, unknown>` cast.
  - Its parameter stays `unknown`. It is a published `@objectstack/plugin-auth` export, and narrowing it would be a breaking input narrowing inside a widening card. The #24196 contract review (`6240835611`, ③ item 1) made the same call for `ResolveAuthzInput.getSession`.
  - `isPlatformAdminUser` keeps `unknown` too, because it also judges raw user rows (`admin-impersonate-endpoint.ts`: the caller row and `findUserById`'s target row), the same reason `normalizeAuthGate` keeps `any`.
- **`@objectstack/rest`** (`rest-server.ts`): the `getSession` closure handed to `resolveAuthzContext` returns `Promise<SessionRead | null>`, and `gatedSession` becomes `SessionRead | null` instead of `any`.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**:
  - `dispatcher-plugin.ts` `readGatedSessionUser`: `session: any` is dropped. `api` there is already the contract's handle.
  - `security/resolve-session-principal.ts` `resolveSessionData` returns `Promise<SessionRead | null>` instead of `Promise<any | undefined>`. It reads `authService.api` / `getApi()` through `IAuthService` instead of three `as any` casts, with the same branches. It is module-internal: `index.ts` does not export it.
  - `http-dispatcher.ts`: both reads (`enforceAuthGate`, `enforceProjectMembership`) are typed.
- **`@objectstack/cloud-connection`**: `sessionFromAuthService` and `ResolvedSession.readFrom.sessionData` (`unknown` becomes `SessionRead | null`) in `cloud-connection-plugin.ts`. In `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, `resolveActiveOrgId` and the install-local `getSession` bridge.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-webhooks`**: `resolveSession` returns `Promise<SessionRead | null>`.
- **`@objectstack/service-storage`**: `buildGetSession` returns `Promise<SessionRead | null>`. The `session: any` in the upload-stamp resolver and in the posture reader is gone.

### The top-level `activeOrganizationId` operand is removed at both sites (Prime Directive #12)

Producers measured: the only in-tree `auth` service is plugin-auth's `AuthManager` (`auth-plugin.ts`, `ctx.registerService('auth', this.authManager)`). Its read is better-auth's `getSession`, and its `customSession` returns `{ user: { ...user, positions, isPlatformAdmin, authGate? }, session }` (`auth-manager.ts`). No production code produces a top-level `activeOrganizationId`. The one test fixture that did was `sys-file-organization-stamping.test.ts`, "accepts the flattened shape a host may hand back directly", which pinned the fallback itself and named no producer.

- `storage-service-plugin.ts`: `session?.session?.activeOrganizationId ?? session?.activeOrganizationId` becomes `session?.session?.activeOrganizationId`. The docblock that described the fallback is corrected.
- `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` `resolveActiveOrgId`: `… ?? session?.activeOrganizationId ?? null` becomes `session?.session?.activeOrganizationId ?? null`.
- Pins: the storage fixture is flipped to "does not read a top-level `activeOrganizationId`" (no stamp). `marketplace-install-local-no-active-organization.test.ts` gains a `topLevelOrg` case: walled, with only a top-level `activeOrganizationId`, the reseed answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the missing active organization, and no seed run starts.

### The `undefined`-direction pin on `judgePlatformAdmin`

`platform-admin-gate.undefined-direction.test.ts`: a signed-in user (with an `id`, so the 401 cannot mask the 403) is refused **403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`**, and `isPlatformAdminUser` answers `false`, in each of these cases: both fields absent; both explicitly `undefined`; `role: null`; `isPlatformAdmin: false`; `isPlatformAdmin: 'true'` (truthy is not `true`); `role: 'Admin'`. Controls: `isPlatformAdmin: true` and `role: 'admin'` still admit, and the admitted actor is `{ id, email }`.

### Changeset

`.changeset/24222-get-session-readers-declared.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor` (a published contract widens; `Clause-②: yes (widening)` in its body). `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `rest`, `runtime`, `cloud-connection`, `plugin-webhooks` and `service-storage` are `patch`: type-only reader edits, plus the fallback removal, which is a fix and carries its one-line remedy for an auth service that answered the flattened shape. Not breaking, so no ADR-0087 marker is owed.

## Verification (head `05c1551c`, after merging `origin/main` `9040945d`, which carries PR #24224)

- **Build:** the dependency closure of the six reader packages, plus `@objectstack/spec`, `rest` and `plugin-auth` again after the merge: `os-verify-lock` VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter … typecheck`, exit 0 for `spec`, `plugin-auth`, `rest`, `runtime`, `cloud-connection`, `plugin-webhooks` and `service-storage`. `rest`, `plugin-auth` and `runtime` were re-run after the merge: exit 0.
- **Tests:**

  | Package | Script | Result |
  |---|---|---|
  | `spec` | `test` | 691 files / 20974 passed |
  | `spec` | `test:repo` | 67 / 1115 |
  | `rest` | `test` | 294 / 6027, post-merge |
  | `rest` | `test:repo` | 5 / 258 |
  | `runtime` | `test` | 409 / 6280, post-merge |
  | `runtime` | `test:repo` | 3 / 808 |
  | `plugin-auth` | `test` | 159 / 3105, post-merge |
  | `cloud-connection` | `test` | 51 / 602 |
  | `plugin-webhooks` | `test` | 19 / 201 |
  | `service-storage` | `test` | 59 / 1029 |

  Every row exited 0.
- **Reverse verification (types):** a `user.positions` read added to `judgePlatformAdmin` fails `tsc` with TS2339 against `{ id?; email?; name?; authGate?; isPlatformAdmin?: boolean; role?: string | null }`, so the rebuilt `dist` declaration is the one being read. The organic red was the `user.name` TS2339 above, before `name` was declared. Both mutations ran under `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which confirmed the blob was restored to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- **Ablation (operand removal):** with `?? (session as any)?.activeOrganizationId` put back, the storage pin fails (1 failed / 11 passed) and the install-local pin fails (1 failed / 7 passed). The tree was restored to HEAD each time, per the tool's blob check.
- **Generated artifacts:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0, before and after the merge. No export is added or removed, and no Zod schema is touched.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 93 commands, and the same list again on the merged head. Run on head `05c1551c`: 92 exit 0. One is NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exits 3 because its fixture needs `git fetch --unshallow` (a shallow clone); `Lint & Repo Gates` carries it. `--ran` reconciliation: "93 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 92 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

## Acceptance notes

- **The `SessionRead` alias** now exists as a module-local copy in 9 modules: 2 from #24196 and 7 here. An exported `@objectstack/spec/contracts` alias would give it one spelling, at the cost of a public export and an api-surface entry. It is not added here. Each copy derives from the contract, so the copies cannot drift apart.
- **`cloud-connection-plugin.ts` `sessionFromAuthService`** resolves `api` as `getApi()`, then `authSvc.api`, then **`authSvc` itself**. The last operand treats the service as its own session handle, which is a shape `IAuthService` does not declare. It is not an `activeOrganizationId` operand, so it is outside this card's Done-when, and it is left as is.
- **`content/docs/kernel/contracts/auth-service.mdx`** names `AuthSessionApi` but does not restate its result shape, so it still reads true and is unchanged.
